title: Excel Fullstack Manual
description: A self-study manual in four phases: HTML and CSS, JavaScript, a project you plan yourself, then TypeScript and Next.js 14. Includes the projects listed on this site. Written to be used offline.

title: HTML, CSS and JavaScript Mastery Manual
description: A self-study manual in four phases, from HTML and CSS fundamentals to TypeScript and Next.js. Word document.

title: Image fitting and CSS debugging
description: Four short lessons from a real debugging session: fitting a large image into a small box, a typo that stopped the stylesheet loading, a class name on the wrong element, and img versus CSS background-image. Ends with a checklist.

title: Project 1: Personal profile page
description: Build a responsive profile page. Tests HTML structure, text elements, images, links, the box model, flexbox and basic CSS.
build: A profile photo or avatar at the top (any image file)
Your name as the h1 and your title as the h2
A short bio paragraph
A skills section listing your tech stack
A projects section with 2 to 3 project cards
A contact section with links
A page that works on both mobile and desktop
steps: Create index.html and style.css in the same folder.
Write the full HTML boilerplate first.
Add all your HTML content, with no CSS yet. Get the structure right.
Add a CSS reset and box-sizing.
Style the body: font, background colour, max-width and margin: 0 auto.
Build and style each section one at a time.
Add hover effects on project cards and links.
Add a media query so it looks good on mobile.
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 3, Project 1. It includes starter HTML to read and then type yourself.

title: Project 2: Responsive pricing cards
description: Build three pricing cards that rearrange for desktop, tablet and mobile. Tests CSS Grid, flexbox, variables, hover effects and responsive layout.
build: Three pricing cards: Free, Pro and Enterprise
Each card has a plan name, a price, a feature list and a button
The middle card (Pro) is highlighted with a different border or background
Desktop: all 3 cards side by side
Tablet: 2 columns
Mobile: 1 column, stacked
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 3, Project 2. It includes the key CSS techniques and a dark mode challenge for when you finish.

title: Project 3: Navigation bar with mobile menu
description: Build a fixed top bar that turns into a hamburger menu on phones. Tests flexbox, CSS transitions, position fixed, z-index and media queries.
build: A fixed top navigation bar with the logo on the left and links on the right
Desktop: all links visible in a row
Mobile: links hidden and a hamburger icon (three lines) visible
Clicking the hamburger shows and hides the menu
The menu slides in with a CSS transition
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 3, Project 3. It includes the key HTML structure.

title: Project 4: Login and signup form
description: Build a login form that switches to a signup form. Tests forms, input styling, CSS pseudo-classes, validation states and transitions.
build: A login form with email and password inputs
A "switch to signup" link that shows the signup form
A signup form with name, email, password and confirm password
Focus styles on inputs (blue border when clicked)
Error styling (red border and a message for invalid input)
Forms centred on the page, with a max-width of 400px
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 3, Project 4. It includes the key CSS for form styling.

title: Project 5: Todo list app
description: Build a todo list that remembers your items after a refresh. Tests DOM manipulation, events, localStorage, dynamic rendering and array methods.
build: Add a todo by typing and pressing Enter or clicking Add
Each todo shows its text and a delete button
Click a todo to mark it complete (strikethrough)
Filter todos: All, Active and Completed
Show the count of remaining active todos
Save all todos to localStorage so they survive a page refresh
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 5, Project 5. It includes the core JavaScript structure.

title: Project 6: Quiz app
description: Build a multiple-choice quiz with a score at the end. Tests arrays of objects, dynamic rendering, score tracking, conditional logic and DOM updates.
build: 5 to 10 multiple-choice questions stored in a JavaScript array
One question at a time with 4 answer options
Correct or incorrect feedback after each answer
A progress bar showing the current question number
A final score screen with a percentage and a restart button
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 5, Project 6. It includes the data structure for the questions.

title: Project 7: Weather app
description: Build a weather app that looks up a city. Tests the fetch API, async/await, real JSON data and dynamic DOM updates. This one needs an internet connection while you test it.
build: A search box where the user enters a city name
Fetch the city's coordinates from the Open-Meteo geocoding API
Fetch the current weather for those coordinates
Show temperature, weather condition, wind speed and humidity
Show a loading state while fetching
Show an error message if the city is not found
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 5, Project 7. Open-Meteo is free and needs no API key.

title: Project 8: Expense tracker
description: Build an income and expense tracker that saves your entries. The manual calls it the most advanced Phase 2 project. Tests objects, arrays, reduce, dynamic rendering and localStorage.
build: Add income or expense entries with a description, an amount and a type
Show running totals: total income, total expenses and balance
List all transactions, colour-coded (green for income, red for expenses)
Delete individual transactions
Save all data with localStorage
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 5, Project 8. It includes the core data structure and logic.

title: Capstone: Church registry in Next.js
description: The manual's final project: build a church registry app with Next.js 14 and TypeScript, with proper architecture, TypeScript types and Next.js routing. It needs Node.js and an internet connection to set up.
answers: Fullstack Manual, Chapter 9. It includes the project architecture, the TypeScript types and the registration form component.

title: Practice files: login form and JavaScript switch
description: Two small, unfinished practice files: a login form page (HTML and CSS) and a JavaScript switch statement example. Both still contain mistakes, so you can open them and try to fix them.

title: Learn how to use Google Fonts
description: A very small repo with a short note on loading a Google Font with a link tag in the head, plus a sample page.

title: W3Schools
description: Free tutorials and references for HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with examples you can try in the browser.

title: MDN Web Docs
description: Mozilla's free reference for HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Look things up here when you want the exact rules.

title: freeCodeCamp
description: Free lessons and projects for learning to code, including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
